question: What is the meaning of weight in relation to physical properties, technical properties?
description: Weight in relation to physical properties refers to the measure of the force exerted on an object by gravity, typically represented in units like kilograms or pounds. In the context of technical properties, weight can be a crucial aspect to consider for various products or materials, especially when assessing factors like structural integrity, transportation requirements, or load-bearing capacities.
